description: The sets of books (businesses, household, nonprofits) this connection may reach: the ones the user chose when connecting. Each has a bookId to pass to the other tools, its currency, fiscal year end, status, and whether drafts can be prepared there. When its plan is not paid, deletionDueAt is the date the books will be deleted (3 months after the plan stopped) unless the user updates the payment method or pays what is owed; tell the user, and suggest exporting a backup.
name: list_books
title: My sets of books
